_metadata.description: Enhanced course index with additional features from Coursera products
fields: id - Integer ID for each course
url - Full URL of the course/product
productType - Type of product (COURSE, SPECIALIZATION, PROFESSIONAL_CERTIFICATE, etc.)
avgProductRating - Average rating (float, can be null)
productDifficultyLevel - Difficulty level (BEGINNER, INTERMEDIATE, ADVANCED, MIXED, or null)
productDuration - Duration category (e.g., ONE_TO_FOUR_WEEKS, ONE_TO_FOUR_YEARS, etc.)
isCourseFree - Boolean indicating if course is free
skills - List of skills covered in the course
fullyTranslatedLanguages - List of languages with full translation
subtitlesOnlyLanguages - List of languages with subtitles only
subject - Subject area (Business, Computer Science, Data Science, etc., or null)
